name: Sweden (Stockholm municipality)
kernel_gaps: piecewise-linear allowance in multiples of an index amount, rising then falling, exact rational coefficients, one rounding up to 100 (grundavdrag 63 kap. 3, 3 a §§)
credit defined through another part: (formula(arbetsinkomst) - grundavdrag) x municipal rate (jobbskatteavdrag 67 kap. 7 §)
credits limited to one of several taxes (municipal only vs municipal + state) applied in a statutory order across two tax pots (67 kap. 2 §)
fees on taxable income with their own caps (public service-avgift 1 % up to 1,55 ibb; begravningsavgift)
withholding-table function (whole-percent table number, assumed fee share, band top) to compare published tables with the statute

validation.referee: OECD Taxing Wages 2025 (SWE, 8 family types x 7 lines: CGTC, CGITLETC, CGITFP, SLT, EECSSC, CTGG, THP)
validation.notes: model run with the OECD's national average municipal rate 32,41 % and no begravningsavgift; THP differs only by the OECD gross's öre (<1 kr); the OECD books all credits as central tax and leaves the public service-avgift out (F7)

validation.referee: Skatteverket, Teknisk beskrivning SKV 433 2025: worked examples
validation.notes: grundavdrag, förhöjt grundavdrag, state tax, pensionsavgift (incl. the 50-kr tie and the maximum), jobbskatteavdrag, förvärvsinkomst credit, public service, two full low-income computations; Lean theorems by decide (SETax/Tests.lean)

validation.referee: Skatteverket allmänna skattetabeller 2025 (open data, monthly, tables 29-42, columns 1, 2, 3, 6)
validation.notes: table cell = statute model at the band top with municipal rate T - 1,16 % and fees 1,16 %, /12 rounded down (harness/table_check.py); percent rows above 80 000 kr/month: 360 919 of 360 928 200-kr steps equal the half-up percentage, 9 exact x,5 ties kept low (F6)

headline: Sweden 2025 reproduces the OECD, 22 of Skatteverket's worked examples and all 26 936 withholding-table cells exactly; the statute's credit order leaves working pensioners earning up to 213 000 kr paying the 7 % pension fee uncompensated, and IL 67 kap. 2 § does not say which tax a two-tax credit uses first (up to 3 520 kr).
